title.zh: U.S. added just 29,000 jobs in September, with unemployment rate rising to 4.2%
title.en: U.S. added just 29,000 jobs in September, with unemployment rate rising to 4.2%

current_state.zh: U.S. September nonfarm payrolls came in at just 29,000 versus 90,000 expected, with unemployment rising to 4.2% and July revised to a 10,000 job loss, leaving bitcoin up about 2% near $86,600 as traders weighed easier Fed policy.
